name: HCSR04

specs.voltage: 5V (not 3.3V tolerant — use level shifter on ECHO)

pins.label: TRIG
pins.note: Pulse high ≥ 10 μs to start measurement

pins.label: ECHO
pins.note: 5V output — voltage divide to 3.3V for ESP32/RP2040

tips: ECHO line is 5V — use a 10kΩ/20kΩ divider before feeding into a 3.3V MCU.
Reflective surfaces and angles below 30° cause missed echoes.

alternatives.name: VL53L0X
alternatives.note: Time-of-flight laser, more accurate, much smaller, 3.3V, but max ~2 m and pricier.

alternatives.name: JSN-SR04T
alternatives.note: Waterproof variant if you need outdoor / wet use.
